title: The Pea Test
target: The Princess and the Pea, with noisy snack testing
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: A pea was in her bed. Dot lay on a rug. Gus ate in his den. Dot did not nap. She did not see a pea. "Is a rat in my bed?" Gus got his tin. He put it by her ear. Dot sat up. "Oh, it is you!" Dot put a cap on his tin. Gus did not eat. Dot had her nap.

title: The Ice Hat
target: Magical party outfits that do not last the dance
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had an ice hat. Bo had a hay hat. Kit got a wet ear. Bo got an ant in his fur. At a big hop, all had to do a jig. Kit put her hat in a tub. Bo put his hat in too. The hay got wet. The ice was not a hat now. Kit and Bo did a jig. No hat got in the way.

title: The Long Nap
target: Sleeping Beauty, with a pie that beats a noisy rescue
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had to nap for an age. Ned had to end her hex. He hit a tin. Fay did not get up. He hit a pan. Fay did not get up. Ned set a pie by her lip. Fay sat up and ate. "Is the hex at an end?" Ned did ask. Fay ate a bit. "Yes. But I may nap for an age if you get me a pie."

title: The Small Giant
target: Jack and the Beanstalk, with a giant who needs smaller furniture
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip put a pea in a pot. It got big. Pip got up to a den in the sky. Max sat on a bed as big as a hut. "I am a big guy," Max did say. Pip saw he was not big at all. He got a box for Max. Max sat in it. Pip got the big bed. Now he had a hut in the sky.

title: The Bog Costume
target: Enchanted animal identities, with a soggy pretend eel
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo sat by a bog in a red cap. "I am an eel." Dot did ask him to dip in. Bo did dip. His cap got wet. "I am not an eel!" Dot got his cap out. She put a pea in it. The cap sat on the bog. The pea had a tub now. Bo had no cap. Dot let him use her dry rag. It fit him.

title: The Red Hat
target: Little Red Riding Hood, with the delivery eaten en route
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had a red hat and a big bag. In it was pie, jam, a cup, and a rug. Gus was to get the bag. Kit did not get it up. Gus ran to her. He ate pie. Kit ate jam. Kit and Gus lay on the rug for a nap. Kit got the bag up now. Gus got it. "I got a cup and a nap. Oh, my!"

title: The Three Huts
target: The Three Little Pigs, with a fan as the wind tester
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had a hay hut. Fay had a log hut. Bo had a tin hut. Gus had a big fan. He let it run by the hay hut. The hut had a dip. He let it run by the log hut. A log hit the sod. The tin hut did hum. All sat in it. Gus set his fan to low. Now the hut was not hot. Ned put hay in it for a bed of hay.

title: The Bare Cap
target: The Emperor's New Clothes, with an edible hat fastener
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a hay cap. "No oaf can see it," he did say. Pip saw it. The air got it off Max. All did cry in joy. "It is in the oak," Pip did say. Max got it. Pip put a nut on it to pin it to Max. Max ate the nut. The cap was off now.

title: The Rescue Net
target: Tower rescues, with an easier exit behind a rug
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot sat in a den up in an oak. Kit was on the sod. Dot let a net go. Kit got in it. Dot did tug him up. Kit had jam. Dot ate it. Kit saw a gap by a rug. A log led out of it to the sod. Kit got to the sod by it. Dot had the net for her jam pot.

title: The Pie Trail
target: Hansel and Gretel, with the trail eater hired as guide
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus and Bo put pie by a log and by an oak. A jay ate the pie. Bo did not see how to go. Gus fed the jay a nut. It led him to an oak. Gus and Bo had a hut up in it. Bo put the jay on a map in ink. Gus put a nut by its lip. "We can pay our pal." No jay ate the map.

title: The Seven Seats
target: Snow White's crowded cottage, with a log everyone prefers
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay saw a hut. Dot and her kin sat in it. Dot had a cup for Fay. Fay sat on a pot. It did hum. She sat on a box. It had jam in it. She sat on a log. Dot and her kin sat on it too. Fay got up and sat on a mat. Now the log had no gap, but Fay had all the mat.

title: The Egg Quest
target: Epic treasure quests, with a hen claiming the ceremonial drum
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip had a map. Ned had a tin to hit. Pip led Ned by a log to a hen. It had an egg. Pip got it. Ned hit his tin. The hen sat in the tin. Pip saw an egg in it. Pip got an egg and Ned got an egg. Ned did not get his tin. He had to use a pot. The hen had a new bed. Pip had his tea.

title: The Rod in the Jam
target: The Sword in the Stone, with a warm jam jar deciding succession
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: A rod was in jam. Max did say, "Who can get it may be my son." Bo dug in the jar. The rod did not go. Bo set the jar in hot tea. He got the rod out. Max got him a cap. Bo put it on the jar. His law was to let no fly get at the jam.

title: The Round Rug
target: The Round Table, with a picnic seating dispute
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had a rug for her kin. All had to sit on it. Bo did not get a bit of rug. Kit put a fig in the pot by her bed. All ran to the pot. Bo had all the rug now. Kit cut the fig up. Bo got a bit too. He sat on the rug to eat it. The kin sat by him, not on the rug. Bo had all the rug now.

title: The Fox Toll
target: Fairy-tale bridge beasts, with a costume paid off in hats
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus had fur and a red wig. "I am a fox. Pay me to get by!" Dot had no gem. She got him a cap. Gus put it on his wig. He did not see. Dot ran by. He put the cap up and saw a nut. Dot put it by him. Gus sat to eat. The fox was not so sly now.

title: The Wish Lid
target: The Fisherman and His Wife, with a practical small wish
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned met an eel. It let him ask for a toy. Bo did ask him to ask for a big hut. Ned got a lid. The eel hid in the bog. Bo was sad. Ned let him see a bee in his tea. Bo put the lid on. Now the bee had a hut too. Ned got a sip of tea at six.

title: The Jug Gifts
target: Aladdin's wishes, with a genie who mishears the order
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit was in a jug. Max got her out. "Ask me for a toy." Max did ask for a car. Kit got a jar. Max did ask for a gem. Kit got jam. Max did ask for pie. Kit got pie. Max ate. Kit ate too. Max put jam in his jar. He got no car and no gem, but his jar had jam. Kit got no jug, but she got pie.

title: The Hungry Hat
target: Enchanted clothing, with a hat that also orders lunch
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip had a hat. It did cry all the way to a pie den. Gus saw Pip at the gap. He got him a bit of pie. The hat did cry. Gus put a bit in it. It did not cry now. Pip did ask for tea. Gus got a cup for Pip and a cup for his hat. The hat got a nap.

title: The Mud Pig
target: Animal transformation tales, with a muddy mistaken identity
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay got mud on her fur. Bo saw her in a tub. "A pig is in our den!" Fay did nod. Bo got the pig a pea. Fay did not eat it. She got a rag and the mud was off. Bo saw Fay. He got her a fig. Fay ate it. Fay put mud on her fur. "The pig may ask for pie!" Bo got the rag, not the pie.

title: The Sleep Race
target: The Tortoise and the Hare, with a victory earned in a teacup
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot and Ned ran to a bed up in an oak. Dot ran. Ned ate a fig. Dot got to the bed and had a nap. Ned got up to her. Dot had all the bed. Ned did say he won, for he did not nap yet. Dot did not get up. Ned had a nap in his cup. He won a bed of his own.

title: The Red Touch
target: King Midas, with washable red dye
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max put his paw in red dye. He was Sir Max for a day. All he got was red. His cup was red. His hat was red. He got a fig. The fig was red too. Max did not eat it. Fay got a rag and a tub. Max put his paw in it. Now he ate a new fig. Fay put his red hat on the tub. It was Sir Tub now.

title: The Lunch Hat
target: Magical school sorting ceremonies, with a bird choosing snacks
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip had to put Kit and Bo in a row. He did use a hat. Kit put it on. It did say, "Nut!" Kit sat by a nut. Bo put it on. It did say, "Fig!" Bo sat by a fig. Pip saw a jay in it. It had a nut and a fig. Kit fed the jay. Bo ate the fig. All got a row now. It was a row for tea. Pip got a cap for the jay.

title: The Low Flight
target: Wizard flying lessons, with a mop better at ground work
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo sat on a mop. "Fly!" The mop did not fly. Gus put it on a toy jet. The jet did fly. The mop got up a bit. It hit a rug. Bo got the mop wet. Now it did a job. He put the jet on a peg. A mop had to fly low to get mud off a rug.

title: The Jam Gem
target: Alchemy examinations, with a snack mistaken for a gem
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had to get a gem out of a nut. She hit it too far. It ran off her mat to a jar of jam. Max saw it. "A gem!" Fay did say it was a nut in jam. Max ate it. He got Fay a gem for her art. Fay put it by the jar. Now the gem was in jam too.

title: The Hat Hut
target: Invisibility garments, with a visible and occupied hat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot had a big hat. No one was to see her in it. Kit saw a paw. Dot hid it. Kit saw an ear. Dot hid it. Kit saw a dot. "Is it a bed?" He sat. Dot did cry. Kit got up. Dot got her hat off. Kit put it on a peg. It was a hut now. Dot put jam in it. Kit did not sit on the jam.

title: The Owl Post
target: Magical owl mail, with a bird asleep through teatime
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had an owl for his job. It had a tag for Pip: tea at six. The owl had a nap. Pip got to Ned at six. "How did you see my tag?" Ned did ask. "We eat at six day by day." The owl got up at ten. It ate the tag. Ned had to pay it in pie now.

title: The Soup Orb
target: Crystal ball predictions, with the ball as a pot lid
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus saw Fay in a big orb. He saw a rod too. "You may sip pea tea." Fay got the orb up. It was the lid of her pot. Gus saw a pea in it. "I see my lot too." He got a cup. Fay let him sip the tea. Gus put it on his cup. Now the orb hid the pea.

title: The Full Flight
target: Flying potions, with a recipe that makes lunch
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a hex in ink. It did say to add tea, fig, and egg to a pot. Dot did it. Max did say a hex to fly. The pot did not fly. Dot ate a bit. Max ate too. "We can fly in a bit," Dot did say. Max had to sit. His hex had fed him.

title: The Rod Shop
target: Wizard wand selection, with a dog choosing the wand
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit got a rod off Bo. She hit a cup. The cup did not do a jig. A dog ran in and got the rod. Bo let it go. Kit got a cup of jam. She put a pea in it. It was a gem now. She ate it. The dog had a rod. Kit had jam.

title: The Pie Sun
target: Magical astronomy homework, with an edible sun setting in a belly
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip had to do art of the sun. Fay had to do it too. Pip got ink. Fay got pie. Pip put a dot in his art. Fay put a nut on her pie. At six, all had a sun. Fay ate her art. "Why did you eat the sun?" Pip did ask. "It set," Fay did say.

title: The Lost Pin
target: Heroic retrieval quests, with a hat gem in a teacup
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had no gem on his hat. Gus dug by a log. No gem. He dug by a box. No gem. Now he got tea. The gem was in his cup. It was a pin. Ned put it on his hat. Gus got the cup. It was a gem too, to his eye.

title: The Tin Rim
target: Epic enchanted ring journeys, with pie cravings that predate the ring
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot got a rim of tin. Bo did say it got him to ask for pie. Dot put it on her paw. She did not ask for pie. Bo had jam on his lip. "You ate pie. You did not see my rim yet!" Dot put a rag in it. Bo ate pie. Dot had a dry lap. Bo had pie. The rim had no hex at all.

title: The Box Map
target: Treasure-map expeditions, with the guide sitting on the prize
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max let Pip use his map to a gem. Pip dug by an oak. He dug by a hut. Max sat on a box to see. Pip did ask how to get in it. Max got up. It had a nut. Pip got the nut. Max put an X on his box.

title: The Laugh Toll
target: Fairy-tale bridge guardians, with a laughter toll paid by a bee
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay sat by a gap. Kit had to get her to cry in joy to go by. He put a fig on his lip. Fay did not cry in joy. He put it on his ear. She did not cry in joy. A bee sat on it. Kit got up and ran. The fig got in her cap. Fay did cry in joy. Kit ran by. The bee had no fee to pay.

title: The Tea War
target: Heroic shields and peace treaties, with a bee kept out of tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus had a tin for his job. Max had a cup. Gus did say his tin was to bar a foe. A bee got in the tea. Max put his cup on it. Gus put his tin on the pot. Now no bee got in. His tin had won a war. Max got the bee a bit of jam so it did not go to war.

title: The Hop Hat
target: Seven-league boots, with a hat that must be worn to work
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo had a hex on his hat. It let him go far in a hop. Ned set a fig on a mat. Bo did hop to it. His hat got off. Bo had to hop to his hat. Now he was by the fig. Ned put the hat on the fig. It did not hop. Bo had to put it on to get the hex. He ate the fig.

title: The Bog Gem
target: Wishing on stars, with a snack seller's lamp reflection
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot saw a gem in a bog. She did ask it for a bun. Pip did ask for jam. Gus had a jug of oil. Its ray was the gem. Gus had a bun and jam too. He let Dot and Pip eat. Dot put a nut by the jug. Now her gem got a tip.

title: The Flying Hut
target: Castles in the clouds, with fog mistaken for flight
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit saw fog by her hut. "Our hut can fly!" Fay got a cup to get dew in the sky. Kit put a net out to get fog. No fog got in it. The fog did go. The hut was in its oak. Fay put tea in the cup. Kit put a bun in the net. "We got sky tea!" Fay did say.

title: The Cow Cap
target: Royal succession contests, with a crowned cow setting the job description
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max hid a cap. Its new pal was to get his job. Bo saw it on a cow. He let the cow eat hay. Its cap got on the sod. Bo got it. He let Max use it. "Why not you?" Max did ask. "The cow ate hay in his cap. I may eat hay for my job." Max hid the cap in his pie tin.

title: The Fig Feast
target: Royal banquets, with a tiny feast followed by edible abundance
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had to eat a lot. Gus had one fig. He cut it up. Fay had one bit. Gus had one bit. It was not a lot. Fay got her bag. It had a big fig pie. Gus cut it up. Fay ate a lot now. Gus put his fig nub on a tin. It was art, not tea.

title: The Bug Portrait
target: Royal portraits, with a bug making the sitter pose twice
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned sat for Dot to do his art. A bug sat on his ear. He hit it. Dot put an arm up in the air in her art. The bug ran to his jaw. He hit it. Dot put an arm by his jaw too. Ned saw a lot of him in the art. "Now I can hit a bug and a bug!" Dot put a bug by one arm and by one arm.

title: The Tin Key
target: Secret palace vaults, with the treasure eaten at once
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip got a key. Kit saw it was tin. "A den may get a gem!" Pip did try a box. No fit. He did try a jar. It did fit. Kit saw a nut. Pip ate it. Kit got one too. Now the gem was in a gut. Pip put the key in the jar. No one had to dig for it.

title: The New Wag
target: Court jesters, with the monarch accidentally getting more laughs
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo was a wag in a wig. Fay had a cap. Bo put a fig up in the air. It got in her cap. All did cry in joy. Fay sat on a tin by her bed. It did hum. All did cry in joy too. Bo got her cap. Fay got his wig. Now the wag had to sit for the gig.

title: The Tub Show
target: Royal processions, with the ruler pushing the new passenger home
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max sat in a tub. Gus did tug it on a rug. It got in mud and did not go. Max got out to tug. Gus sat in it. The tub did go. Gus was in the big gig now. Max ran in the mud. He put his cap on Gus. Gus now had to tug the tub to his hut.

title: The Bee Adviser
target: Fairy-tale animal advisers, with a bee choosing lunch over government
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot had a bee on her cap. She did ask how to do her job. It did hum. Ned put a pea in a pot. The bee did hum. Ned ate a bun. The bee got off. Dot put a bud on her cap. A new bee sat on it. Now Dot did not ask him how. She let it eat.

title: The Running Bun
target: The Gingerbread Man, with a bite stopping a rolling bun
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had a hot bun. It ran off a pan and by a cot. Max ran to get it. He put a tin by the cot. The bun ran in. Kit put an eye on it in jam. It had to see Max eat a bit. It did not run now. Max put jam on its new lip.

title: The Gum Toy
target: The Golden Goose, with a sticky toy sending everyone to a bath
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus put gum on a toy. Pip got a paw on it. The paw did not let go. Dot got her paw on Pip. Kit got her paw on Dot. All had to go to a tub. Gus got the gum off. Pip did ask, "Is it a fun toy?" "It got us all in one tub!" Kit hid the gum.

title: The Paid Tin
target: Magic mirrors, with a cleaner charging for each answer
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had a tin to see her eye. She did ask who had the top hat. Kit got a rag. She got the fog off the tin. Fay saw her cap. She did ask who had the top hat now. Kit put a hat on the tin. Fay saw no one. Kit got a fig to get it up.

title: The Tea Pin
target: Epic compass-guided journeys, with the pointer following a metal rod
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had a pin to be his map. It did aim at a rod. Bo had it in his paw. Bo ran to a cot. Ned ran too. Bo ran to an oak. Ned ran too. Bo sat. Ned sat. Bo put the rod by a cup. Ned had tea. His pin had got him to tea at six. He had to get a map for the way to his hut.

title: The Yam Coach
target: Cinderella's carriage transformation, with the pumpkin becoming supper
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Dot was to go to a hop. Fay hit a yam to get a car. It was yet a yam. She hit it to get a nag. It was yet a yam. Dot put it in a pot. It was tea now. Fay got jam for it. Dot and Fay ate. No car had to go to a hop in her own den.

title: The Egg Password
target: Secret palace passwords, with a guard who gives away the answer
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo had a job by a gap. All had to say egg to go in. Pip did not see how to get in. "How can I go in?" "Say egg," Bo did say. Pip did say egg. Bo let him by. Pip put a tag up. It had egg on it. All got in. Bo had to use fig.

title: The Ant Exam
target: Wizard levitation exams, with an ant earning the grade
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had to get a lid up. She did hum a hex. The lid did not go up. She put a nut by it. An ant ran to it. The nut was at its rim. The ant got the lid up. Fay put an A on a tag for the ant. Kit got a B for the nut. The ant ate the tag.

title: The Silent Court
target: Royal silence decrees, with the king supplying the noise
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a new law. No din in his den. Dot sat and did not hum. Max ate a fig. "Hic!" Dot put a lid on his cup. Max got a sip. "Hic!" Max cut his law up. Dot did hum. Max hit his cup on a pan. Now hic was in the gig.

title: The Royal Bow
target: Elaborate royal gifts, with the gift wrapper tied up instead
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip had to tie a bow on a box. He had a rag. He did tie one end to a paw. He did tie one end to an ear. Ned saw a bow, but no box. Pip did not nod. His ear had to tug his paw. Ned cut the rag and put it in the box. "A bow kit!" Pip did nod now.

title: The Royal Pan
target: Royal status tied to clothes, with a pan receiving the bows
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Dot and Fay and Max, monkeys
text: Dot put her cap on a peg. Fay put a pan on her top. Max saw Fay. "Sir Fay!" He did bow and got her a fig. Dot had to rub mud off a pan. Fay put her pan on a peg. Max did bow to the peg. Dot put her cap on her pan. Max got it a fig too.

title: The Bog Hero
target: Grand bridge-building quests, with the goal brought to the hero
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had to get tea on the far end of a bog. He did not opt to get wet. He put a log by the bog. It did not get to the far end. He put a net on it. It did not get to the far end. Bo had a new pot of tea. He put it by Ned. Ned sat to sip. Bo put pie in the net.

title: The Late Spell
target: Magical school spell books, with a bedtime spell during a test
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: At ten, Kit had to do a hex. Gus got her a tag to use. Kit did say the hex. Gus had a nap. Kit had a nap too. At six, Kit got up. Gus got up too. Kit put the tag by a bed. The hex was not for her try. It was for a nap.

title: The Name Tag
target: Rumpelstiltskin, with the secret name worn on a hat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Fay and Gus, monkeys; Kit and Max mentioned as guesses
text: A sly imp had a gem. Fay had to say who he was to get it. She did try Kit. The imp did say no. She did try Max. The imp did say no. He did bow. His hat got off. It had Gus on it in ink. Fay did say Gus. She got the gem. Gus hid his hat in a bag.

title: The Ice Seat
target: The Snow Queen, with a throne that becomes a puddle
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo had a bed of ice. Dot ran in. She had hot tea. Bo set the cup on his bed. The ice got wet. The bed got low. Bo sat on the sod. Dot got him a box. Bo put a rug on it. Now he had a dry bed and a cup of tea on ice.

title: The Vanishing Grade
target: Wizard school invisible ink, with the pupils choosing their own grades
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Fay and Kit and Bo, monkeys
text: Fay had a pen. No one saw its ink. She put an A on a tag for Kit. Kit did not see it. Bo saw no ink. Kit did say she had an A. Bo did say he had an A too. Fay got a new pen. It had red ink. Kit and Bo had a new try. Now Bo had a B. Kit had a C. Bo did ask for the old pen.

title: The Pie Cottage
target: Thumbelina meets edible fairy-tale houses, with a very small dinner guest
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Pip was as big as a pea. Dot set a big pie by him. Pip ate a bit. He did not eat it all. He ate a gap for his den. Dot put a cup by it. "Now tea is by the den." Pip sat on a pea. "I may eat my bed too."

title: The Endless Cup
target: Bottomless magical cups, with a tea bath ending the serving job
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Dot and Ned, monkeys
text: Bo had a cup. He put tea in it. He had all the tea in a sip. He did say a hex. Now tea did not end. He let Dot sip. He let Ned sip. Dot put the cup in a tub. She let tea run out. Bo sat in the tub. His tea had no end, but his job did.

title: The Gem Tea
target: Stone Soup, with the stone receiving the credit for lunch
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Gus and Ned and Dot and Bo, monkeys
text: Gus had a gem but no pie. He put it in a pot of hot tea. Ned put a fig in it. Dot put an egg in it. Bo put an oat in it. All ate. No one ate the gem. "My gem got me tea!" Gus did say.

title: The Little Hat Shop
target: The Elves and the Shoemaker, with hats made for tiny customers
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had a rag to sew for a cap. At ten, Bo got it. He cut it up. He did sew a cap for an ant, a cap for a bee, and a cap for a fly. At six, Kit saw the ant, bee, and fly in a row. All had a cap. Kit put a bag on her top. "Now I fit in."

title: The Pet Test
target: Magical familiar inspections, with the hidden pet eating the grade
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had to get a pet for Bo to see. Her pet rat hid in a bag. Bo saw no rat. Kit put a pea by the bag. The pea was not by the bag now. Bo saw no rat. Kit put jam by the bag. The rat ran out. It had jam on its jaw. Bo put an A in the bag. The rat ate it too.

title: The Midnight Dye
target: The Twelve Dancing Princesses, with the royal investigator joining the jig
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Max and Fay and Dot, monkeys
text: Max saw mud on a rug. At ten, he hid by a bed. Fay and Dot did a jig. Max put red dye by the gap. It got on Fay and Dot. Max had to tap a paw to the jig. It got red too. At six, all had red fur. Max put a rug in his den for a jig at ten.

title: The Royal Cat
target: Dick Whittington's Cat, with peace achieved through naps
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit let Bo use her cat to get a rat. Bo put the cat in his den. It had a nap. The rat had a nap by it. Now no one ate his pie. Bo had a nap too. Kit got a tin of tea for her cat. The cat did not get up. It had a job to nap.

title: The Bee Piper
target: The Pied Piper, with one bee following the music to tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had to get a bee out of the den. He did hum. The bee did hum. Ned ran out. The bee did fly out. Dot sat to sip her tea. Ned did hum to get in. The bee did hum too. Dot put a cup by the gap. "Tea for two!" Ned let the bee sip too.

title: The Bat Bed
target: Magical summoning lessons, with the wrong word furnishing the pet's home
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus had to get a bat by a hex. He did say bed. A bed was in the den. Bo did ask him to try bat. Gus did say bat. A bat was in the den too. It had a nap on the bed. Bo put an A on a tag. Gus had got a pet and its cot.

title: The Hay Prize
target: Royal horse races, with the winning horse eating the crown
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a nag for a run. It did not run. Dot set an oat by its lip. It ate. Dot set an oat by the far end of a rug. It ran to it. Max won a cap of hay. The nag ate it too. Max had no cap, but the nag won tea.

title: The Forbidden Pot
target: Forbidden fairy-tale chambers, with the hidden occupant giving itself away
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo had a pot. "Do not get its lid up." Kit did not get its lid up. She sat by it. The pot did mew. Bo ran in. "Did you see my cat?" "No. It did mew." Bo got the lid up. The cat got out. Kit put the lid on his top. "Mew for me!" Bo did mew. The cat had a nap.

title: The Covered Law
target: Royal proclamations, with a pie hiding the prohibition
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a law on a tag: No pie. Dot put a pie on the tag. It hid the No. Max saw pie. He ate it. Now he saw No pie. Dot saw no pie too. She got him a new tag: No tax. Max put pie on it at six. Dot ate the pie. Now she saw No tax. She put a nut in her bag.

title: The Royal Toe
target: Royal seals, with a toe signing better than a whole paw
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had to put a paw in ink for a law. He put his paw on a tag. The tag was all red. The law was hid. Dot got him a new tag. Max put one toe in ink. It fit. Dot had his law. "My toe has a job," Max did say. "My paw has a nap."

title: The Fan Hex
target: Magical school wind spells, with a switch doing the real work
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Gus put a tag on a peg. A fan let it fly. Gus did say a hex to get it low. It did not get low. Bo hit a pin on the fan. The fan did not run. The tag got low. Gus put the pin in his kit. "A hex in a pin!" Bo put the fan in the kit too.

title: The Huge Yam
target: The Enormous Turnip, with tea doing the last part of the work
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Pip and Dot and Bo and Ned, monkeys
text: Pip had a yam in the sod. He did tug. It did not get up. Dot did tug Pip. Bo did tug Dot. Ned put tea in the sod. It got wet. The yam got up. Ned had no tea. All had a yam. He put it in the pot. Now all had yam tea. Bo had a mug of mud.

title: The Brave Fly Saver
target: The Brave Little Tailor, with a heroic reputation earned from one fly
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo had to sew a cap. A fly sat in his jam. Bo got a rod to get it out. He put it on a rag. It did not fly. Bo got a fan. It did fly. Max saw a tag on Bo: I won. Max let Bo sit by his gap. Bo put jam by it. A fly was in his new den. "I may win all day!"

title: The Twin Mop
target: Magical duplication spells, with the duplicate refusing the same chore
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had to mop a den. She did say a hex. A new Kit was by her. "Mop for me." "No, mop for me." Kit and Kit sat. Dot put a mop by one and a mop by one. Now Kit and Kit had to mop. Kit had a pal, but no nap. Dot put a tag on the new Kit so she saw who was who.

title: The Fan and the Pie
target: The North Wind and the Sun, with pie persuasion beating a fan
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Dot and Pip, monkeys
text: Bo had to get a cap off Pip. He got a fan. Pip put a paw on his cap. Dot got a hot pie. Pip put his cap by her to eat. Bo got his fan off. He ate pie too. Dot put the pie tin on her top. Now Dot had a cap too. No one did try to get it off.

title: The Fur Hex
target: Rapunzel and overpowered hair-growing spells, with an overcorrection
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had a hex for her fur. It got to her toe. She cut it. It got to her toe. She cut it. Dot did ask if she had to say the hex to end it. Fay did say it. Now she had no fur. Dot got her a rug. Fay put it on. "I may try a new hex."

title: The Fox Alarm
target: The Boy Who Cried Wolf, with a polite fox and a teatime alarm
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit did cry, "Fox!" Gus ran to see. He saw no fox. Kit did cry, "Fox!" Gus ran to see. He saw no fox. A fox sat by Kit. Kit did cry. Gus did not run. The fox put a fig by Kit. She ate it. Gus got a fig too. Kit did cry, "Tea!" Gus ran for a cup.

title: The Royal Parcel
target: Royal couriers, with the recipient hiding inside his own parcel
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Pip and Ned, monkeys
text: Bo hid in a box for fun. Pip did not see Bo. He put a tag on it: To Bo. Ned got it. "It is for Bo." "I am Bo!" Ned got the lid up. Bo got out. Ned put the box by Bo. "I got it to you. You got out of it. My job can end."

title: The Last Hot Dog
target: The Three Wishes, with the wishes undoing the snack
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Fay and Pip and Bo, monkeys
text: Fay let Pip use a hex. He did ask for a hot dog. A hot dog was by him. Bo did ask for one on Pip. Now Pip had a hot dog on his lip. Pip did ask for no hot dog. It was not on his lip now. Bo had no hot dog. Pip had no hot dog. Fay had a hot dog of her own.

title: The Crowded Ark
target: Noah's Ark, with the passengers packing their own furniture
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Bo let a cat in his ark. The cat had a mat. Bo let a dog in. The dog had a bed. He let a pig in. The pig had a tub. Now Bo did not fit. He put his own mat on the top. "I can see all of you!" The pig put its tub on top too. Bo had to fit in the tub.

title: The Fog Lesson
target: Wizard weather lessons, with the teacher joining the hidden naps
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Kit and Gus, monkeys
text: Bo did use a hex for fog. Kit hid in it. Gus hid in it. Bo saw no pal. He did use a hex for sun. Kit was on his cot. Gus was on his rug. Kit and Gus had a nap. Bo lay on the sod. He did use his fog hex. Bo hid his nap in the fog.

title: The Court Picnic
target: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse, with royal bowing spoiling tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Gus and Bo and Max, monkeys
text: Gus had a den in an oak. Bo got him to a big den for tea. Max hit a pot. All had to bow. Gus sat to eat. Max hit the pot. All had to bow. Gus got his fig and ran to his oak. Bo ran too. Max hit his pot. No one did bow. Max ran to the oak for tea.

title: The Net Champion
target: Heroic contests, with a spectator winning the tug of war
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Pip and Dot and Bo, monkeys
text: Pip had one end of a net. Dot had one end. A tug of war was on. Pip did tug. Dot did tug. Bo sat in the net. Now no one won. Pip and Dot put the net by a bed. Bo did not get up. He got his nap in the net. "I won," he did say.

title: The Paper Fox
target: Wizard paper-animal enchantments, with the animal succeeding as a placemat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had to do a hex on a tag. She cut it to be a fox. Bo did ask it to run. It did not run. He did ask it to sit. It did not sit. Kit put a cup on it. "My fox has a job." Bo put an A on it. The fox was a mat for his tea.

title: The Tall Band
target: The Bremen Town Musicians, with the frightened host joining the stack
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Pip and Kit and Gus and Dot, monkeys
text: Bo had a hut for a gig. He did not let Pip, Kit, Gus, and Dot in. Pip sat on Kit. Kit sat on Gus. Dot sat on Pip. All did hum. Bo saw a big mob. He ran out. The mob got in. Pip put a rug by Bo. "We can hum for you." Bo ran in. He sat on top. He had to hum too.

title: The Polite Rod
target: Magical tools that obey courtesy, with a wand awaiting permission
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Fay had a rod. "Get the cup." It did not go. "Get the pot." It did not go. Dot did ask, "May I use you?" The rod did hop. It got the cup. Fay put a bow on the rod. "May I?" The rod did bow. It got the pot. Dot put tea in it. The rod got a cup too.

title: The Rug Landing
target: Flying carpet quests, with a teapot acting as the landing brake
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Ned had a rug. It did fly. He had to get it to sit. He put a net on it. The net did fly too. Bo put a pot on it. The rug sat. Ned put tea in the pot. Now his rug was a mat for tea. Bo put a tag on it: Do not fly at tea.

title: The Just-Right Pot
target: Goldilocks and the Three Bears, with the temperature tests mixed together
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Kit and Pip and Dot, monkeys
text: Bo saw a cup of hot tea. He did not sip. He saw a cup of ice tea. He did not sip. He saw a pot. He put the hot tea and ice tea in it. Kit, Pip, and Dot ran in. Bo had tea for all. The pot was not hot and not ice. Bo had no cup now. He had to use the lid.

title: The Air Market
target: Enchanted market bargains, with the customer selling a rival invisible product
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a jar of air. It had a tag: New air. Dot did pay a nut for it. Max got the lid up. Dot did not see her air. She put a new nut in a jar. "Nut air for you!" Max did pay a gem. Dot got her nut out. Max saw no nut air.

title: The Sitting Hex
target: Perseus and Medusa, with the gaze making everyone sit instead of turning to stone
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max had a hex on his eye. If he saw you, you had to sit. Pip hid by a big tin. He put it up. Max saw his own eye in it. He had to sit. Pip ran by him. Max put a rag on his eye. Now no one had to sit. Pip let Max put a paw on him. Max got to his den.

title: The Royal Act
target: Royal talent auditions, with two performers sharing one job
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Max and Ned and Bo, monkeys
text: Max had one job for an act. Ned did hum. Bo did a jig. Max had to pay for one. He put Ned and Bo on one rug. Ned did hum as Bo did a jig. Now it was one act. Max put a nut on the rug for pay. Ned ate a bit. Bo ate a bit. Max did a jig too. He got no nut.

title: The Box Tower
target: The Tower of Babel, with builders making a toy village instead
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Ned and Pip and Dot and Bo and Kit, monkeys
text: Ned had to get a hut up in the sky. Pip put a box on a box. Dot put a box in a box. Bo put a box by a box. No one saw a hut in the sky. Kit put a toy in one box. She put a mat in one box. Now all had a den for a toy. Ned put his toy on the top.

title: The Pen Zoo
target: Magical conjuring homework, with a shopping list becoming pets to feed
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Kit had a pen for a hex. She put "fig" on a tag in ink. A fig was on her mat. She put "pie" on it. A pie was on her mat. She put "cat" on it. A cat was on her mat. It ate the pie. Kit put "dog" on it. A dog was on her mat too. Bo got the pen out of her paw. Kit had to get tea for a cat and a dog now.

title: The Ant Rescue
target: The Lion and the Mouse, with a monkey king misunderstanding the ant's preferred reward
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
text: Max got a paw in a net. He did tug. It did not go. Dot did tug. It did not go. An ant bit a bit of net. The net let Max go. Max put a gem by the ant. It got a nut, not the gem. Max bit the gem. "Ah. I see." Dot got him a nut.

title: The Royal Sun
target: Royal astronomers and grand requests, with sun mistaken for son
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Max and Dot and Ned, monkeys
text: Max had no sun in his den. He did ask Dot for one. Dot got Ned, his son. "A son for you!" Ned was not hot. Max put sun on a tag in ink. Dot lit a wax rod. Now Max had a sun in a tin. Ned had tea for two.

title: The Jig Job
target: The Red Shoes and dancing enchantments, with the dance repurposed as cleaning
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Bo and Kit and Dot, monkeys
text: Bo had a hex for his paw. It did a jig. He had to sit. The paw did a jig. He had to eat. The paw did a jig. Kit put a mop in his paw. Now his jig got mud off the rug. Bo put a cap by his mat. Dot put a nut in it. His jig had a job for tea.

title: The Early End
target: Fairy-tale endings and overpowered narrative spells, with dinner ending too early
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk A
cast: Kit and Bo and Ned, monkeys
text: Kit had a hex for end. She put it on a tag. Bo had to dig. Kit put the tag by him. He sat. Ned had to sew. Kit put the tag by him. He sat. Kit had to eat. Kit put the tag by her pie. She did not get a bit. "Not yet!" She cut the tag up. All got up. Kit got her pie.

title: The big cup
target: Underdog sports final won by an accidental assist
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip had to get the cup. Kit had to hit a red orb. Pip saw a fig by the net. He ran for it. Kit hit the orb. It hit the paw of Pip and got in the net. The ref let Pip win. Pip put his fig in the cup. Kit did not get a cup. He got a wet rag to rub it.

title: The mud run
target: Training montage defeated by a mud puddle
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Bo ran up an oak. Max sat in mud. At the big run, the ref put a tub at the end. Bo ran so far he did not see it. Max got up to get him. His paw hit the tub. Max won. He put mud in the cup. Bo got a mud pie.

title: The ice star
target: Skating finale becomes an accidental cleaning job
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Dot had to win an ice cup. Gus had to mop the ice. Dot did try to hop. Her paw hit the mop. Dot sat on it. Gus did tug it by a tie. Dot did ski by the ref on the mop. She won the cup. Gus got tea in it as his fee.

title: The slow race
target: Racing drama rewards a sensible pit stop
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Fay had a car. Ned had a van. One peg on his van was bad. Fay ran off to win. Ned got a new peg and put it in. Fay had no way to end her run. She hit the hay at the end. Ned won. He got Fay out of the hay. She had a nap in it as he got to his den. She did not get up to get her car.

title: The grand kick
target: Penalty kick suspense derailed by cleanliness
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip had to hit an orb to win. Bo was in the net. Bo saw jam on the orb. He got a wet rag to rub it. Pip sat on the sod. Bo got the jam off. The ref got Bo a bib. Pip hit the orb. It got in the net. Bo got jam on the bib. It was on his paw all the day.

title: The pie hat prize
target: Cooking contest awards a hat prize after a flying pie lands
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Kit put his pie up on a box for the ref to see. The air got the pie to Dot. She put it on her ear as a hat. The ref saw her. He did say Kit had won the hat cup. Dot ate the rim of her hat. Now it did not fit.

title: The soup test
target: Secret recipe exposed by the chef's fur
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Gus had a pot of pea tea. Fay had to say the mix to win a fig. She had a sip. She did not see it. A pea got off the fur of Gus. Fay saw it. She did say pea and won. Gus hid his fur in a hat.

title: The cake bed
target: Giant baking contest fails at serving time
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Max had a pie as big as a bed. Ned had one as big as his paw. Max had to cut his pie for the ref. The saw got in it and did not get out. Ned got the ref his pie. Ned won. Max put a rug on his pie and had a nap. As he got up, the saw was yet in it. It had its own rug.

title: The hot dish
target: Heat contest prize solves the winning dish's problem
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Bo had a pot too hot to eat. Dot had a fan. Bo did not let her use it. His pot had to be hot to win. The ref got a bit and ran for ice. Bo won a fan. Dot put it by her fan. Bo did not let her use it. He did not eat, but he had a cup and a fan.

title: The egg act
target: Chef show produces an accidental sandwich
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip did lob an egg up for a pie cup. Fay had a pan. The egg hit an oak and got on his ear. Fay got a bun to mop it up. The ref ate the bun and egg. Pip won the cup. Fay got him a pan as a hat. Pip did lob an egg. It hit the pan, not his ear.

title: The lost gold
target: Pirate treasure map leads to an endless loop of maps
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Kit had a map to a gem. Gus had to dig by an oak. He dug a big pit. Kit saw a box in it. Gus got the box. It had a gem and a map. Gus saw the new map. It led to the oak too. "No," he did say. "One pit is my lot."

title: The sea hat
target: Pirate captain gives his hat authority and another pirate sits on it
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Bo had a hat to use at sea. Fay had a sea tub. Bo put his hat on and got in. The air got his hat off. Fay got it on a rod. Bo did bow to the hat. "The hat is now the big guy," he did say. Fay got the hat off the rod. She sat on it. "Now I am on top."

title: The plank game
target: Snack stacking delays the walk along a pirate plank
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Max bid Dot go on a log by the sea. Dot put a nut on it. Max put a nut by it. Dot put a fig on it. Max put one too. The log did dip. Dot sat on dry sod. She got her fig off the log. Dot ate her dry fig. Max had to get his wet fig.

title: The hat in the fog
target: A stealth captain mistakes his own hat for danger
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Ned had to lie low in his sea tub in fog. Pip had to be mum. Ned saw a rag in the fog. "Not one cry," he did say. The rag got to Ned. Ned did go, "Ah! Ah!" Pip got the rag. "The hat of Ned!" Ned hid his red ear.

title: The pond chase
target: Pirate pursuit ends at a floating picnic
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Gus saw Kit row off in a sea tub. Kit had his box. Gus ran to get a tub too. He got to Kit by eve. "My box!" he did say. Kit put it in his lap. It had a bun for Gus and a bun for Kit. Gus ate his bun. Kit ate her bun. "Do we row now?" Gus did ask. Kit put on her nap cap.

title: The hungry art judge
target: Western drawing duel is judged by a referee who expects a real pie
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: At ten Fay met Bo by an oak. Bo had a pen. Fay had one too. "I can win," Bo did say. He put an oak on his pad in ink. Fay put a pie on her pad. Gus saw the art. He put an X by the pie. "No pie for me? So no cup for you!"

title: The nut herd
target: Western supply drive delivers goods but leaves a passenger behind
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Dot put a nut bag in a van. She had to get it to the inn. Max had to sit on it. Max hit a peg. The van ran to the inn. Dot ran for it. The inn got its nut bag. Max sat on Dot. She had to get him to the den. He got to sit at the end.

title: The dry well
target: Frontier water crisis is a lid misunderstanding
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip got to a pit to get a sip. Ned had a cup. "No tea in it," Ned did say. Pip got a rod. The rod hit a lid. Ned had put it on the pit. Pip got the lid off. Ned got a sip. "A new pit!" Ned did say. Pip put the lid on. "Now it is old."

title: The new law
target: Sheriff violates his own mud rule
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Kit was the law at the inn. "No mud on the rug!" he did say. Fay saw mud on his toe. Kit put a paw on the rug to let her see his pin. Fay hit a tin pot. Kit had to rub the rug. He got his pin off. He put it on the mop. Now it was the law.

title: The toy bus chase
target: A dramatic chase for a ride that goes nowhere
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Gus ran to get a bus. Bo had a van. "Hop in!" he did say. The two ran to the bus. Gus got on. He sat by a tot. Bo saw it was a toy bus. It did one lap and got to Bo. "I got you to the bus," Bo did say. "Now you can get me to the den."

title: The vault job
target: Disguised fig heist reaches a shop checkout
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Dot saw a fig in a box. Pip had a map of the den. He put on a wig to fox the cop. Dot got low. She got the fig. The cop put out a cup. "One nut," he did say. Pip got his wig off. He hid his map in it. "Can I pay in fur?"

title: The fake gem
target: Gem heist trades one wax imitation for another
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Max had a wax gem. Kit had a bag. Max got to the gem on a peg. He put the wax one on the peg and got the old one. Kit put the old gem in her bag. The sun was hot. The gem was goo by ten. Max did pat the one on the peg. It was goo too.

title: The safe code
target: Safe cracking reveals a lunch box with a ticking toy
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Fay hid a bun in a box. Gus had a key. He put his ear to the box. "Tic, tic!" he did say. Fay did ask why a bun did tic. Gus got the lid off. A toy was by the bun. Fay had put it in. Gus ate the bun. "Yum! I win the bun and its toy."

title: The decoy
target: Heist distraction wins a fake prize for a fake pie
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Bo put a mud pie on a box to fox Ned. Ned got all to see it. Bo hid by an oak and ate a fig pie he had got off Kit. Ned won a cup for the mud pie. Bo did go to Ned. "It is my pie!" Ned let Bo get the cup. It was mud too.

title: The laser maze
target: Laser maze heist is actually a washing line
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip saw a red tie in a den. Dot had to put it up. Pip had to get a gem on a box. He got low and did pad. The tie hit his ear. A wet rag hit his lip. Dot saw him. "My rag!" Pip put the gem on the box. He had to put the rag up. It was his own bib.

title: The deep cave
target: Expedition monster is a hungry companion
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Kit and Max got in a pit. A low din was in it. Kit lit a log. Max hid. The din did not end. Kit saw Max had no bun. He fed Max a fig. The din did end. Kit put a bad guy on the map. Max put a fig by it. "It can eat the fig, not us."

title: The vine cafe
target: Jungle crossing becomes a fruit delivery
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Gus saw a tie by a gap. Bo got on it. He did hop to an oak. Gus did not go. Bo fed him a fig. Gus ate it. "I am to get by the gap," Gus did say. Bo fed him two. Gus ate the two too. "No," Gus did say. "I can sit by the gap and eat."

title: The rare bloom
target: Expedition for a rare bloom finds a dressed twig
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Fay had to get a red bud. Pip had a map. The two saw red by a log. It did bob. Pip hid. Fay ran up. It was Dot in a hat. Dot let Fay get the red bow. Fay put it on the map in ink. Pip did say he had to get a bud yet. Dot put the bow on a rod. "Try now."

title: The old ruin
target: Treasure expedition misreads a map to a tea shop
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Ned saw ink on a bar. Kit had a pad. He did say the ink was a map to ore. Ned dug and dug. Kit saw TEA on the pad. It did not say ORE. The ink led to an inn. Ned got tea. Kit got to fix the pit. Ned let him use his cup.

title: The great peak
target: Mountain expedition climbs a moving van roof
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Dot and Gus got up a big top. Dot put a tie on a rod. Gus put up a rag. The big top was the top of a van. The van did go. The cab man got the two to the den. Dot put one nut in his paw. Gus ate his fig. "I was at the top," he did say. "Now I can sit in the van."

title: The prize door
target: Game show contestant hands chore prizes back to the host
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Fay had a red box and a tan box. Bo had to get one to win a cup. Bo got red. It had a mop. He got tan. It had a wet rug. "No!" Bo did say. He put the mop and rug by the cup. "You can win it all now," he did say to Fay.

title: The quiz king
target: Riddle expert loses the box he is sitting on
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Max had to win a cup. Pip sat by him. "No fur. A lid. You can sit on it," the ref did say. Max did not say it. Pip put a paw on the box Max sat on. Pip won. He got the box for his den. Max had to sit on the sod.

title: The big spin
target: Prize wheel winner risks the prize to spin again
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Kit had a rim on a rod. He hit the rim to win a pie. It got off the rod and did zip to a pie inn. Dot ran to get it. Kit got the pie. Dot got the rim. Kit did ask for a new go. Dot put the rim on his pie. "Hit it now."

title: The silent round
target: Silence contest prize gets eaten by the helpful loser
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Gus had to sit on a log to win a fig. Ned had to be mum. A fly sat on the lip of Gus. Gus did fan it off. The fly sat on Ned. Ned did go, "Ah!" Gus won the fig. The fly sat on it. Gus did not eat as the fly was on it. Ned got it off. He ate the fig for Gus.

title: The best guess
target: Counting contest consumes its own contents
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Fay had a nut jar. Max had to say how big the nut sum was. Fay let him get it. Max ate a nut. He ate two. He did add as he ate. Max got it all and won the jar. Fay put one nut in it. "Try now," she did say.

title: The royal bath
target: Royal bath ceremony gives a toy the best seat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Pip had a hat for his dip. Gus had a tub. Pip sat in it. Gus put hot tea in it. The hat hid the eye of Pip. Gus got it off. Pip put it on a toy. Gus did bow to the toy. "Sir, you can go in." Pip had to get out of the tub to bow too. The toy got the dry mat.

title: The red rag quest
target: Grand detective hunt finds the missing cloth being worn
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk C
text: Dot had no red rag. Bo ran to aid her. The two dug in a box and in the jam pot. Bo put the box and pot on a map. Dot sat for a nap. Bo saw the rag on her leg. He put DOT on the map. Dot put BO by it. "I got you too!"
