target: Spy password gets mistaken for a food order
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max met Gus at a tea hut. "The red hen has a tan hat," Max did say. Gus got him a red cup and a tan lid. "I ask for the key!" Max did cry. Gus put a key in the cup. Max got it. He had to pay for tea too.

title: The moon mop
target: Space conquest brings responsibility for muddy footprints
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip won a run to a tan orb. "I own it all!" His fur put mud on it. Fay put a mop in his paw. Pip had to mop his mud up. He was an orb guy who had to mop all day.

title: The nut shield
target: Invincible hero armor attracts snacks
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit has a nut mat to bar a foe. Bo let a pea hit it. No pea got by. Bo saw a nut to eat. Kit let him eat it. Dot ate one too. The mat had a gap now. Bo let a pea fly at Kit. She ate it to win.

title: The red clue
target: Detective mistakes a trail left by a tool
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a red rag she did not see. Gus had a map to aid her. He saw a red dot on a pot. "A cue!" But his pen had no cap. It put the dot on the pot. Dot got her rag off his map. Gus put on the pen cap.

title: The tiny sun
target: Miniature science experiment becomes a bedtime lamp
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay has a sun in a jar. Ned put his toy jet by it. The jet got hot. Fay put the jar on ice. The ice got wet. Ned put the jar by his bed. He can see his map now. At ten Fay put a lid on the jar. The sun got to nap too.

title: The jet pot
target: A stealth spacecraft carries a noisy alarm pot
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo has a jet of tin. It has no din. Max has to get it by Gus. Bo put a pot in it. "Hit it to get aid." The jet hit a log. The pot hit Max. Gus got up. Bo put a rag in the pot. Now the jet can get by Gus.

title: The gum trap
target: Supervillain trap catches the wrong object
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned put gum on a mat to get Pip. Pip saw it and ran by. Ned ran to see how he did it. His fur got in the gum. Pip got his arm. The mat got up too. The two had to hop to the tub. Ned had to ask his foe for aid.

title: The pea jet
target: A space expedition ends in a cup of tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot set a pea jet on a pan. Kit was the top guy. "To the far rim!" Dot hit the pan. The pea hit a cup. Kit had to get it out. It was too far in. Dot put hot tea in it. Kit ate the pea. The big run was to tea.

title: The oak key
target: Secret mission discovers an ordinary welcome
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had a key to an oak hut. She hid it in her fur. Gus sat by the hut. Fay got by a log. Her key hit the mud. Gus ran out. "You can tap," he did say. Fay did tap. Gus let her in. Her spy hut had no use for a key.

title: The web bed
target: Hero rescue gear turns into a hammock
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max was up in an oak. Kit set a web to get him out. Max got in it and lay low. Kit did tug. Max did not get up. "Are you ill?" "No. It is a bed." Kit got in too. By six the two had a nap. No one got out.

title: The echo foe
target: Space warrior battles his own echo
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo had a rod in a den on a red orb. "Who is in the den?" he did cry. "Den!" Bo bid the foe go. The foe bid him go too. Ned put a rug up in the den. No foe! Bo put a nut on the rug as pay for its big act.

title: The wax clue
target: Mystery witness is a wax figure
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus had a hat he did not see. A wax toy sat on a box. Gus did ask it for aid. It did not say a bit. Gus sat by it all day. The sun got hot. The toy did bow. His hat got off it. Gus did bow to it too.

title: The new paw
target: Robot hand mistakes a handshake for a command
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max got Dot a tin paw. It can use a cup and a key. Dot got Pip in a hug. The tin paw did not let go. Max hit a red dot on it. It let Pip go and got Max. Dot sat. Her pal had to aid her. The paw did not let him go.

title: The ice ray
target: Freeze ray solves a picnic problem
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned has an ice ray. He can aim it at Pip. Pip has a cup of tea. Ned let the ray hit it. Now the tea is ice! Kit is by him to eat. She put a fig by the ray. Now it is ice too. Ned had to be the big guy. Now his job is to ice tea.

title: The map fold
target: A secret spy delivery turns out to be a picnic errand
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay has a map in a can. Bo bid her cut it by the red ink. She did. Bo put the map in a box. He put a fig in it too. "Get it to Dot." Fay saw the way now. It was not far to a mat. Her spy job was to put a fig in a box.

title: The egg alarm
target: A guarded treasure is an egg claimed by its hungry guard
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus has an egg in a tin box. Kit has to sit by it. At six, Gus hit a pot. Kit put a net by the hut. Gus ran in. Kit did not let him by. "I am to eat," he did say. Kit saw his tin rod to eat the egg. She got the egg. "The top guy is me!"

title: The sock comet
target: Astronomers mistake laundry for a celestial threat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot saw a red dot by her toy sun. Max put his eye to a gem. "A hot orb!" Dot hit a pot. Max put a net in its way. It got a rag. Bo ran up to get it. He had let it fly at a peg. His big orb was but a rag.

title: The glow mask
target: Secret identity is exposed by costume design
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit has a red hat. It can get lit. Fay got ill. Kit lit her hat to get Fay to her hut. At six Kit got to a fig hut. Her hat lit up. "Hi, Kit!" all did cry. Kit hid it in a bag. The bag lit up. So it was not a spy hat.

title: The soft launch
target: Rocket launch interrupted by a pillow dispute
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo has a jet in a box. Pip got in, a pad on his lap. Pip did not let Bo get on the pad. Bo got one end. Pip got the far end. The two did tug. The box did rip. Bo got a bit of a pad. Pip got a bit too. The big war got the two a bed.

title: The spy pie
target: Secret message is eaten by its recipient
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay put a spy tag in a pie. Ned was to see it at six. He ate it at ten to six. Fay ran in to get his spy tag. Ned had no tag. Fay got him a new pie, a tag on top. It bid him get a pie. He had a pie all day.

title: The odd print
target: A detective mistakes a hat worn on a toe for a giant footprint
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus saw one big paw dot and one wee paw dot in the mud. Was a big guy out for a run? Bo sat on a log. He had one hat on his toe. Gus ran up. Bo got it off his toe. Gus saw a big dot in the mud. The big guy was a hat!

title: The shrink hat
target: Shrinking machine affects only an accessory
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a box to get Kit wee. Kit got in. Max hit a red dot. Kit got out. Her hat was wee. Kit was not. Max did try to do it a lot. The hat got wee. Kit put it on a pea. Max did bow to the pea. It was a toy top guy.

title: The boss seat
target: Space throne is revealed as a folding chair
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned sat on a tan cot at the top of a log. Dot had to bow to him. Her lip hit a cot leg. The cot did sag. Ned and his cot hit the mud. It was fun! Dot put him on the log for a nut. The guy had to pay to sit.

title: The red rope
target: Hero gadget becomes a jump rope
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit has a red web for Gus in a pit. Gus got it. Kit did tug. Gus got up a bit and hit mud. Kit did tie it to an oak. Gus got out. He got one end of the web up. Kit did hop in it. The web was now a toy for all.

title: The wax orb
target: A miniature submarine claims a floating wax bar as a planet
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip put his wee sub in a tub. Dot put a bar of wax in its way. The sub got on the bar. Dot let the tub go dry. "We got to a new orb!" Pip did cry. Dot put a dry rug by him. His new orb was for a tub. He had to let Dot use it at his dip.

title: The false code
target: A spy mistakes a sleeping toe tapping a pan for a coded signal
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay got a rap in a hut. She put it on her pad. Max had a nap by a pan. His toe hit it as he lay on his cot. Fay got him up to ask for the spy key. He had no key. She put the pan on a peg. No rap! The spy was a toe.

title: The tea jet
target: A space traveler discovers that snacks still fall
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo has a nut on a web in his toy jet. "All can fly up in air!" Gus cut the web. The nut hit Bo. Gus put a bag of tea on the jet. It got cut. Bo had tea in his fur too. His jet was for tea, not for the sky.

title: The lens fog
target: A detective mistakes a dirty viewing gem for mysterious fog
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus saw a fog in his gem. Pip saw tan sky. Gus did aim at a sea. Fog! He did aim at his toe. Fog! Pip got the gem and did rub it. Gus had put hot tea on it. The fog was out. Gus got a rag for his kit. Pip got the tea.

title: The loud hush
target: Stealth gadget announces silence
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a box to cut all din. Fay put it in her bag. The box did cry, "Shh!" Gus got up. The box did cry a lot. Fay set it by a sea and ran. Gus bid it end the din. It did not end it. Max got a new box. Fay did ask for no din at all.

title: The hat fan
target: A hero cools a bun but sends it to the wrong mouth
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit can fan a big red hat. Dot had a hot bun. She may not eat it yet. Kit got in to aid her. The hat put air at the bun. Kit hit it as she ran by. Bo ate it out of the air. Dot put the hat on Bo. "You can fan my new bun."

title: The star queue
target: Space villain enforces an unexpectedly fair rule
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned sat at the way to a toy sun. Bo had to get by him. He got a rod of tin. Ned put up one paw. "Get a tag." Bo got one. He was two. Dot was one. She had a go on the sun toy. Bo put his rod low. A go in a row was fun. A war was not.

title: The spy scent
target: An invisible spy reveals her location by answering a question about tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay has a kit you may not see. She got in the hut of Pip to get a spy tag. "Is it hot tea?" Pip did ask. Fay had a cup. "Yes," she did say. "You are by my bed!" Pip put a tag by the cup. Fay got it. Her tea was bad spy kit.

title: The lid ray
target: An opening ray spills ink and accidentally summons a tea guest
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a ray to get up a lid. Gus did use it on an ink jar. The ink hit his fur. Gus did use it on a tin box. The lid hit a pot. Dot ran up for tea. Max sat on a mat of ink. Dot put a cup by him. "Is it tea?"

title: The hat hunt
target: Missing artifact turns out to be a nesting place
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a hat she did not see. Gus saw a bit of oak on a rug. He ran to an oak. Dot had put her hat on it. It had a nut, a fig, and fur in it. Bo lay by it. It was his tea bed. Dot got her hat. Bo had to use a pan.

title: The ice hut
target: A villain writes his plan on transparent walls
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned has a hut of ice. His aim is on the ice. Kit can see it. He is to get her in a pit. Kit put a log on it. Ned ran out to tip her in. He hit the log and sat low. Kit put a rug on his ice. His aim was hid now.

title: The slow beam
target: Time slowing gadget makes a snack take forever
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip got a ray to fix a fig in the air. Max let a fig fly to him. Pip did use the ray. The fig was in the air. Pip had to sit to eat. Max ate and had a nap. Pip cut the ray off. The fig hit his lip. To eat, you may let a fig go.

title: The coin ship
target: Spacecraft runs out of arcade tokens
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo put a fee in his toy jet. It had a hum. Fay had a sun hat. The two saw a red orb on its map. The jet was off. Bo had no fee. Fay put a nut in it. No hum. The two sat on a red rug. Now the rug was a red orb. It had no fee.

title: The dark lamp
target: A light rescuer exposes a villain who has not prepared for battle
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned got his hut dim. Kit ran in, a jar of sun in her paw. No ray! Ned had to cry for joy. Kit got the cap off the jar. The hut lit up. Ned was in a rug. Kit let him use his hat. A foe has to get up to put on his hat for a war.

title: The tip jar
target: Spy dead drop is confused with a cafe tip
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay put a key in a jar at a tea hut. Gus was to get it. He put a nut in the jar. Fay got in. The key had a nut on it. Gus had put all his pay in a tip jar. Fay got the key and a pie. Her spy job had got pay for tea too.

title: The mud bot
target: Cleaning robot makes its own footprints
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a bot to mop mud. Dot put a mop in its paw. It can mop a bit. Its fur put mud on it as it ran by. Dot got a rug for it to use. No mud! Max had to cry for joy. The bot did bow and got in the tub. Dot had to mop now.

title: The lost sun
target: Space mystery is solved by moving a hat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus saw the sun go dim in his gem. Bo hit a pot. All ran up. Gus saw a big orb in the sky. Kit got a hat off the gem. Bo had put it on to bar mud. The sun was out. Bo had to hit the pot to end the din.

title: The soft rod
target: A chosen ruler uses a useless weapon to fetch a snack
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip got a rod out of a pot. Ned did bow. "You are our top guy!" Pip did try to cut a bit of oak. The rod did bow. It was gum. Pip did use it to get a fig off a peg. It hit his hat. Ned did bow a lot. A guy who can get tea is a fun guy.

title: The tiny gate
target: Science portal connects two nearby picnic plates
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot has a gap in a rim. Fay put a pea in it. The pea got on a pan by her. "A new orb!" Dot did cry. Fay put her paw in. It got by the pea. Dot put a fig in it. At six the two had tea but did not get off the mat.

title: The space jam
target: A heroic space launch is thwarted by sticky fuel
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo put his toy jet on a log. Pip had a jar for the gas. Bo did ask for it. Pip put jam in the jet. Bo hit the red dot to go. The jet did not go. Pip ate jam off the rim. "I can eat the gas!" Bo got a cup to get jam out.

title: The hero tax
target: A superhero toll booth rewards the villain instead
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit sat by a gap in the way. "I can get you up!" Ned had a bag and a fig. Kit got him up in the air. He ate a bit of it on her paw. "Pay me a fig," Kit did say. Ned did not get off. Kit had to eat too. He let her buy a bit for a nut.

title: The ice tag
target: A spy message melts before the meeting
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay cut a spy tag in ice. Gus was to get it at six. Fay put it in the sun by his hut. At six Gus got a wet mat. Fay saw no ice. "Did you get the tag?" Gus did nod. "Yes. I am to mop." He got a mop. Fay had to mop too.

title: The nut case
target: A detective solves a theft by checking an unusual hiding place
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a nut in a box. Now it was not in the box. Gus saw a dip in the lid. He put his paw to it. The nut hit his paw. It was in a gap in the lid! Dot had put the lid on it. She put her nut in a bag now.

title: The car lift
target: A hero rescues a runaway toy car by bundling it and its passenger into a rug
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo sat in a car on a log. The car ran off. Kit ran to aid him. She put a rug in its way. The car got on the rug. Kit got it up. Bo was in a bag of rug now. "I am not a fig!" Kit let him out. Bo got to his hut, his car in his lap.

title: The slow reply
target: A spy waits for a response from a very literal gadget
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max got Fay a spy bot. "Ask it for the key." Fay did ask. The bot put a pea in her paw. Fay did ask a lot. The bot put a pea on her wig. Max saw the pea. "It has a bad ear." Max put a key by it. The bot ate a pea. Fay got the key.

title: The new planet
target: An astronaut marks a discovery on an edible map
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a map in her jet. A red pea was the new orb. Pip ate it. Dot saw no red pea. "We ate an orb!" Pip had to say he ate it. Dot put a fig on the map. Pip ate it too. Dot put a pin on the map. Pip got a fig to eat, not a map.

title: The loud award
target: A hero medal makes stealth impossible
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit won a tin pot for her big act. Fay had to get by Gus. Kit ran to aid her. The pot hit a log. Fay hid in a box. Kit put the pot in it too. Now the box had a din. Fay got out and set it by Gus. Kit had to win a rug, not a pot.

title: The tiny town
target: A miniature city mistakes a rod for an invading spaceship
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max had a wee hut in a pan. Ned put a rod in it. "A big jet!" Max did cry. He put a net on it. Ned got the rod up. The net hit a hut. Max had to fix it. Ned got a tea cup. "A new sea!" Max put a toy sub in it. Ned had no tea now.

title: The secret song
target: A spy signal gets recruited for a dance
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had to hum to get Bo to get a key. She hid by an oak and did hum. Bo had a pot. He hit it to her hum. Fay did hum a lot. Bo did jig. Fay got up to ask for the key. Bo put it in her paw. "We can hum and jig at tea!"

title: The hat choice
target: A hero wardrobe decision takes longer than the emergency
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit had a red hat and a tan hat. Bo ran in. "My fig is too hot!" Kit got the red hat. It did not fit. She got the tan hat. It did fit. Kit ran out to aid Bo. He had put his fig in a tub. Kit had a hat but no job.

title: The flat maze
target: A spy escapes a maze by lifting the entire hay model
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned put a key in a web of hay. Fay had to get it. She ran by a gap and hit a bad end. Ned did nod. Fay put her paw by the hay and got it up. The key was on a mat. "I won!" Ned had to get his web up now.

title: The new airlock
target: A space gate traps a captain because he refuses to remove his hat
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo has a jet in a box. Dot has to see if its gap is big. Bo got in. His big hat did not fit out. "I am the top guy!" Dot put a cup by him. "Tea is out by me." Bo got his hat off. The gap was not bad. The top guy was too big.

title: The fog ray
target: A cloaking device hides its own controls
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a fog ray. He hit it. Fog ran out. Ned hid in it. Ned saw no Max. Max saw no ray. "How do I get it off?" Ned had the ray in his paw. "I can hit it for a nut." Max had to pay his foe to get his own ray out.

title: The red eye
target: A detective mistakes a toy lamp for an intruder
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus saw a red eye in his hut. "Who is in my hut?" It did not say who it was. Pip put a rug on it. The eye got dim. Gus did ask it to go. Pip got the rug off. It was a toy sun in a jar. Gus put a hat on it. "The eye has to nap now."

title: The space seed
target: A growth machine produces an inconvenient tree
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max put a nut in his new box. He hit the red dot. An oak got up in it. Dot had to get low. The oak got Max by his hat. "Get me out!" Dot cut a bit of the box off. Max got out. His box was now a hut in an oak.

title: The spy sneeze
target: An undercover agent struggles with a scratchy wig and a loose fastener
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay hid in a hat hut. Kit had a wig for her. Fay put it on. A bit of fur got on her lip. "Ah!" Fay did cry. Kit got it off. Fay put a nut in the wig to pin it on. The nut hit her toe. "Ah!" Fay had to be a spy in a cap.

title: The soft landing
target: A pilot's heroic landing is actually a bed bounce
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip put his toy jet on a bed. Bo got in. Pip hit the bed. The jet got up and hit a cot. Bo got out. "I got to a new orb!" Pip did hop on the cot too. The new orb was fun, but Bo had to set his bed for a nap.

title: The pie clue
target: A detective obtains a confession by offering a replacement snack
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus had a pie. Ned had jam on his lip. "Did you eat my pie?" Ned did not say yes. Gus got a new pie. "It is for the guy who ate my old pie." Ned put his paw up. Gus put his old pie tin in it. "You can rub it." Ned got the tin, not the pie.

title: The boss bot
target: A robot emperor is defeated by a seating arrangement
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot has a bot as top guy in her toy hut. "Sit!" it did say. Dot sat. "Sit!" Max sat too. "Sit!" Dot put the bot on a cot. "You too," she did say. It did not get up. Dot and Max ran out to hop. The top guy had to sit as the two ran and had fun.

title: The red gem
target: A detective exposes fake treasure by dipping it in tea
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned put a red nut in a box. "It is an odd gem!" Gus did not pay. He put it in his tea. The tea got red. Gus got the nut up. The red was jam. Ned had no odd gem now. Gus got a nut. Ned got a cup of jam tea, not a bag of pay.

title: The giant pea
target: A growth ray turns an escape plan into dinner
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max put a pea in his ray box. He hit the red dot. The pea was as big as his hut. Kit was by the gap. The pea hid it. "How do we get out?" Max got a rod. Kit got a cup. The two ate a way out. Max had no use for a big pea at tea.

title: The SOS snack
target: A space distress call advertises a missing condiment
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip put SOS on his toy jet. Fay ran up to aid him. "Are you ill?" Pip did not nod. He had a fig and a cup. "I ask for jam." Fay got him a jam jar. Pip got SOS off the jet. Fay put it on her bag. Now she had no jam for her own fig.

title: The spy bow
target: A greeting code turns into an endless polite contest
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had to bow to Bo to get a key. She did bow. Bo did bow too. Fay got low. Bo got low too. Her hat hit his hat. The two sat in the mud. Fay got a key off his hat. Bo got her spy tag off her hat. The two had met, but no one had got up yet.

title: The hero net
target: A rescue net catches a hero's own lunch
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot was in a pit. Kit had a net to get her out. Kit put it by Dot. Dot got in. Kit did tug. A nut in her bag got in too. Dot ate it. Kit got her up. Dot got out. "Can I get in it?" she did say. Kit put the nut bag in a box now.

title: The tan cap
target: A detective finds a missing cap that has changed color in dye
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max had no red cap. Gus saw a red dot on a log. He ran by it to a cup. Max had put his cap in the cup. Gus got it up. It was tan. "A new cap!" Max saw his tan dye by the cup. Gus had got the cap and a way to dye it.

title: The safe seat
target: A spy refuge becomes an advertised cot with a mysterious tapping sound
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay hid in a big box. Ned sat on its lid. Fay had to get out. She did rap. Ned did not get up. He put a rug on the lid. "A fun cot!" Fay did rap a lot. Ned got up. Fay ran out. Ned put ink on a tag. "Cot for you. It can rap."

title: The tin wig
target: A gadget disguise attracts the entire tea set
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max got Bo a tin wig. It had a red gem in it. The gem can get tin to hug it. Bo put it on to be an old guy. A tin rod got on it. A tin pin got on it too. Bo ran to the tea hut. A cup got on his wig. Max got the wig off. Bo had no wig, but he had to rub the tea set.

title: The space toll
target: A galactic toll collector accepts an awkward form of payment
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned put a rim by a red orb. "Pay a nut to get by." Dot had no nut. She had an oak in a pot. Ned got it. Dot got by. Ned had to add dew. Dot ran up, a cup in her paw. "Can I get a nut?" Ned sat by his oak. It had no nut yet.

title: The hero pose
target: A hero speech gives a stranded friend a convenient landing platform
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip was up on a log. Kit ran to aid him. "I am the top guy!" Pip did ask for a web. Kit put one paw on her hip. "I am so big!" Pip got on her hat. Kit hit hay. Pip got out. "You did aid me," he did say.

title: The sum bot
target: A calculator answers a math question with a snack
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a sum bot. Dot put a nut and a nut by it. "One and one?" The bot did not say two. It ate a nut. Dot did ask a lot. It ate the new nut. Max had to get the nut jar. The bot had a sum now. "No nut!" Dot had to nod.

title: The dry clue
target: A detective finds the stolen jam jar after the culprit washes off the evidence
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus had to see who ate his jam. Bo had jam on his paw. Gus ran to get his map. Bo put his paw in a tub. No jam! Gus saw no jam on Bo. But Gus saw his jam jar in the tub. "You can rub my jar now." Bo got a rag.

title: The pit prize
target: A superhero award is more useful as rescue equipment
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay was in a pit. Kit had won a big cup. She set it by the pit to aid Fay. Fay got in it. Kit got it up. Fay sat in the cup all day. "I am the top pal now!" Kit put it up on a box. Fay had to get out to go to bed.

title: The jet bid
target: A space auction mistakes a friendly greeting for a bid
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned was to let a guy buy a jet. Pip ran in to see him. Pip put his paw up to say hi. "You won!" Ned put the jet by him. Pip had to pay a nut. Pip put his paw up to say bye. "A new jet!" Ned did cry. Pip hid his paw in his bag now.

title: The sea key
target: A spy drops a vital key into a shallow cup
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay got a key off Bo. She hid it in her cup. Bo put tea in the cup. Fay saw no key. "It is in a sea!" Bo got her a rod. Fay got the key out. It was wet but in her paw. Fay put the key in a bag. Bo got his cup of tea now.

title: The oil bot
target: An opening robot oils its owner and is reassigned to a toy car
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max has a bot to get a lid up. Kit did ask to see it. The bot put oil by the lid. It hit a pot. Oil got on a mat. Max had oil on his paw. He hit the mat. Kit got him up. Max put the bot by his toy car. It can oil the car now.

title: The lost badge
target: A detective finds his official name tag stuck to a pie
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Gus had no tag on his bag. Dot saw a pin on a pie. Gus had set the pie by his tag. He got the pin up. The pie got up too. Dot put a cup by it. Gus got his tag off the pie. Now his tag had jam. He had to use a new tag.

title: The hero lift
target: A heroic lifting feat turns the hero into a picnic table
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned had a big log on his lap. Kit got it up. Ned put a cup on it. Kit had the log up. Ned put a pie by the cup. Kit did not let go. "You can eat now," he did say. Kit had to sit, the log on her lap. She was a top pal and a tea mat.

title: The royal pet
target: A space monarch mistakes a toy robot for an obedient subject
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo had a bot on his red orb. "Bow!" The bot did bow. "Bow!" It did bow a lot. Bo sat on his cot. Max put a nut by the bot. The bot ate it. "It is my fan," Bo did say. Max put a nut by his own cot. The bot ran to Max. It was a nut fan.

title: The spy queue
target: A secret meeting is interrupted by a very public line
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay put a spy tag by a fig hut. Pip was to get it. Ten sat in a row. Fay saw Pip at the end. She got him a tag. Pip did not go. "No! It is my go!" Gus did cry. Fay got a fig. She put the tag in a bag and got it to Pip as he ate.

title: The spy swap
target: Secret agents swap their picnic bags instead of mission equipment
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had a red bag. Bo had a tan bag. The two met by a log. Fay got the tan bag. Bo got the red bag. Fay saw no key in it. Bo saw no map in his. Her bag had tea and pie. His had pie too. No spy kit! The two sat by the log to eat.

title: The sky box
target: A toy astronomer mistakes moving display objects for a disappearing sky
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a sun and an orb in her toy sky. Max put the orb in a box. "We had an orb!" He put the sun in the box too. Dot saw no sky. She put her paw in the box. It had the sun and the orb. "The sky is in my paw!" Max had to nod.

title: The big arm
target: A superhero fights a shadow that copies every move
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Kit saw a big arm on her hut. She put her arm up. The big arm got up too. She put it low. The big arm got low. Pip put a mat up to bar the sun. The arm was out. Kit got by the mat. It was up. "My foe is me!" Kit did bow to the sun.

title: The nut pet
target: A retrieval robot adopts a nut instead of following its command
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Max had a bot to get a pea. Ned got it a nut. The bot had the nut and did not go. Max got it a pea. It did not let go of the nut. Ned got the nut. The bot did cry. Max put it in its paw. Ned got the pea. Now the nut had a pet and a tin paw.

title: The web jet
target: A space pilot mistakes his own toy tether for an invisible obstacle
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Bo had a toy jet. Pip put it on a web. Bo got in. The jet got as far as a log. "Why am I by the log?" Pip had the web in his paw. He let it go. The jet got by the log. Bo was off. Pip had to run to get it.

title: The spy ray
target: A laser security system accidentally becomes a limbo game
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had to get by a red ray. Gus had a box to get it low. Fay got low. The ray got low too. Fay got too low to get up. Gus got it low too. Fay lay on a mat. The ray did too. Fay sat up. "You try!" Gus got low. Fay hit the red dot on his box. She got by Gus.

title: The odd egg
target: A detective mistakes a dyed nut for his own missing egg
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Dot had a tan egg in a box. Gus saw it. His egg was tan too. "Did you get my egg?" Dot had a pot of tan dye. Gus saw a rod by it. He got the egg up. It had a cut. Dot cut it up. It was a nut. Gus had to get his egg out of his bag.

title: The hero knot
target: A grand entrance ends with the hero tied down by the work she interrupts
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Fay had to tie a web to a cot. Kit ran in to aid her. "I am in!" she did cry. Kit got her paw in the web. Fay did tie the web to the cot. Kit did bow. The web did tug. Kit sat. Fay had Kit in a web on the cot. "I am in," Kit did say. "I am in a web!"

title: The sleep switch
target: A sleep ray appears effective because its target is already napping
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Ned had a ray to get Bo to nap. Bo lay on a cot. He had a nap. Ned hit the ray. Bo did not go. Ned hit it a lot. Bo did not go. Ned put his ear by Bo. Bo had a nap. Ned sat. He had a nap too. Bo got up and put a rug on him. The ray had won a nap for Ned.

title: The great finale
target: An oversized victory flag is repurposed as a tea decoration
author: IMI Kids Monkey Desk B
text: Pip got to a red orb in his jet. Dot had a red rag on a pin for him. "You won!" Pip got the pin in his paw. It was too big for the jet. Dot put it in a cup and put tea in it. Pip got the cup. His big win was a cup of tea.
